fate_policy.pip_lovers_rule: Only Rylos Vayne Johnson among Pip’s lovers dies, and that death occurs at the end; all other fates require explicit source evidence.
fate_policy.survivors: must be read from final-book/source rules, not guessed

deprecated_variants: any synthetic replacement not explicitly source-mapped
any spelling or alias not explicitly retained as historical evidence
invariants: Pip lover whose death occurs at the end under the explicit endgame rule

relationship_policy: Every major relationship must alter state, carry emotional consequence, retain counter-agency, and persist through the rolling ledger.
Momentous does not mean uniformly tragic; consequence may be care, refusal, repair, betrayal, revelation, or changed world practice.
No generated prose is created by this ledger.
